ticket.title: Eliminate 3D terrain drape tile invalidation (4 FPS) and throttle 3D DOM marker updates
ticket.description: Calling GeoJSON source.setData() at 10 Hz on draped 2D layers (altitude-stems-layer, altitude-shadows-layer, trajectories-layer) forces MapLibre GL to invalidate and re-render all 3D terrain drape tiles 10 times per second (collapsing 3D frame rate to 3.5-4.1 FPS) while geojson-vt strips the 3rd altitude coordinate from LineStrings. Render 3D trajectories and vertical drop-lines in native 3D WebGL without invalidating terrain tiles, skip/throttle DOM Marker.setLngLat when coordinates are unchanged or labels are hidden, and round heading in SVG icon caching.
